headlines.title: Judge dismisses case against ex-FBI agents accused on lying to Congress in Hunter Biden probe
headlines.description: A judge dismissed a criminal complaint against a pair of former FBI officials accused of lying to Congress about what they knew about the Hunter Biden investigation, a person familiar with the matter confirmed to NBC News.

headlines.title: Virginia and D.C. sue to stop proposed Trump arch
headlines.description: Virginia and the District of Columbia filed a lawsuit in federal court Saturday in a last-ditch effort to stop the construction of the triumphal arch planned for Memorial Circle in Washington.

headlines.title: Ahead of Election Day, Trump sets the stage for potential Republican losses
headlines.description: In an election-eve speech at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, President Donald Trump said that Republicans “gave this a very strong shot,” while acknowledging that historically, the president’s party “doesn’t win the midterms.”

headlines.title: Economy, court fights and Dem chaos: Final days of the 2026 midterm race
headlines.description: With 73% of voters dissatisfied with the economy, candidates made their final pitches ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. President Trump campaigned in Iowa and Kansas while Democrats clashed in Michigan. NBC News' Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Defeated Democratic Senate Candidate Backs GOP's Mike Rogers
headlines.description: Democratic congresswoman Haley Stevens who narrowly lost a bitter senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, is turning against the nominee and her party by endorsing Republican Mike Rogers. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports and Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Judge dismisses Trump lawsuit in Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: A federal judge on Sunday rejected the Trump administration’s lawsuit that demanded officials not certify election results in the Senate race there, if the incumbent senator loses. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.
